structure.unit: Interest on Certain Obligations of Government Instrumentalities

law.catch_line: Power to issue obligations not to be denied because interest is subject to federal income taxation
law.text: The power of any governmental instrumentality, to issue or have issued on its behalf for authorized purposes, bonds, shall not be construed to be restricted or limited solely because the interest thereon is subject, in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, to federal income taxes.
